description: "Issaac Watts; his life and writings, his homes and friends" by Edwin Paxton Hood is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The book delves into the life of Isaac Watts, prominently known as a preacher, hymn writer, and theologian, exploring his character, influences, and the impact of his works on modern English hymnody.
